title: 秦依
content_zh:
异界魅影逍遥 秦依 名 3G 网首发

要想成为一个武者，魂，气，技三者缺一不可。缺少任何一项，都不能成为一个真正的武者。

魂，自然是灵魂，其作为武者的重中之重，任何想成为武者的人，都首先得修炼魂力。灵魂修炼到极高境界，据说可以灵魂出窍。当然，灵魂出窍也是极具危险的，没到万不得已，谁也不会轻易做这等事情。

魂力最重要的作用是驾驭斗气。可以试想，如果一个没有灵魂的人体力却拥有斗气，这就好比一头脱缰的野马，不把人折磨的半死才怪。

所以，一个武者，只有在具有足够强大的魂力之后，才能逐渐的提升斗气，让其整体实力得到提升。

武技的存在却是发挥武者实力的。好比武者是一座藏满宝藏的墓穴，那武技就是开启墓穴的钥匙。要不然，任由墓穴里面的宝藏再多，没有开启的钥匙。你也只能看着密封的墓穴叹气。没有武技，就算你有天高的武气，也发挥不出来。

而武技的好坏，就好比钥匙所能打开墓穴门大小好坏。钥匙能打开的门越大，通道越好，宝藏当然就更能搬取了。

拥有一门好的武技，甚至能打败比其高两个阶层的对手，这也说明。武技对于实力的发挥有极大的作用。

一门好的武技，可以大大增强斗气的运用，斗气的施展威力。这也难怪羿流见到日级低阶武技惊骇万分了。

魂力和斗气的修炼功法是根基的话，武技就是工具。根基深厚，再配合优秀工具，对敌事半功倍。

灵魂，斗气，武技三者的功法都分为星，月，日，地，天五个等级。天级功法作为传说的存在，地级功法就算的上最顶级的功法了。就此可以想象，日级也是欲求难得了。这要是出现在大街上，不被人抢的血流成河才怪。

可偏偏这样难求的功法，却被羿锋随意抛给羿流。不得不让羿流惊骇万分。

羿流的好奇就更重了，“草，我这小弟也太牛逼了，他不会做小白脸给赚来的吧？”

羿锋心底嘿嘿直笑，心底诽谤不已。显然，他嫉妒了。

羿锋在接近到前厅时，奔跑的脚步突然停了下来，看着近在咫尺的前厅，忽然慢了下来。

脑海中闪现出五年前一个人的模样，稚嫩的俏脸，明亮的双眸，单薄略显柔弱的身躯，整个人如同含苞待放的百合一样出尘。羿锋曾经不止一次感叹，她要是长大了，不知道会是如何倾国倾城。

但这一切，都不是羿锋脑海中记忆最深的，记忆最深的是她的双眸，内疚而又疼惜的眼神，顾盼之间，摄人夺魄，羿锋清晰的记得，自己经脉俱断时她的痛不欲生，珠泪横落，那善良的绝美，震撼的羿锋心灵，他从来没有想到，世间会有这样让人心惊震荡的眼神。那绝美的脸，配上晶莹剔透的眼睛，那羿锋不止一次觉得自己经脉全断天理不容。

“五年了。你会是何种模样呢？”羿锋喃喃自语，看着近在眼前的大厅之门，却有些不敢迈步。只有在她面前，他才会有如此心态。

羿锋不知道，一年前，两大王级为了在她面前表现一番，相斗的两败俱伤。秦依的美也渲染到极致。

帝国皇帝为此亲自批语道：“红颜祸水，非世间所能拥有。”可以想象，连拥有万千佳丽的帝国皇帝都如此评价，她的美，会是如何的颠倒众生。

羿锋记得，母亲有意无意的不让父亲接触秦依，以父亲榆木脑袋般的专一，母亲还如此做，可见秦依的美会是如何的绝色。

深吸了一口气，羿锋努力的抛却脑海之中的点点想法，迈着步子踏进了前厅，他的轻身轻走，并没有引起父亲寿宴中任何一人的注意，一个个依旧举杯畅饮，喧闹依旧。

一入前厅，羿锋的眼睛就驻留到一个地方一动不动，尽管只是一个背影。但羿锋一眼就认出，眼中的人儿就是自己所寻找的，只有她，才能有这种非世间所有的气质。

从后看去，一头乌黑亮丽的头发阻挡住白腻的颈脖，洁白的连衣裙腰间系着淡绿色腰带，显现出她的高挑纤细。

秦依打量着四周，丝毫不在乎那聚集到她身上的道道失神目光，她只想找到那消失了五年的人。那让她一直深深内疚和想念的人。

羿锋走到秦依身后，轻声的淡淡喊道，语气沉稳至极。

秦依身体一震，猛的转过身子，看着眼前有些单薄的少年躯体，眼眸中的眼泪猛的就流了下来。

如果记忆中的秦依是含苞待放的百合，那现在的秦依已经悄然绽放，白腻成熟的脸蛋点点泪水如同百合身上的雨露。洁白的连衣裙之前打着一个漂亮的蝴蝶结，长腿细腰，婷婷玉立。山峰傲然而立，配合着已经没有生涩的脸庞，风情万种，熟可滴水，居然有着颠倒众生的绝美，re火至极。

羿锋的心猛的跳动了几下，震慑得心旌摇荡。

秦依展颜一笑，这一笑，让所有的人失神：“小家伙，以后不能再莫名其妙失踪了。要一直陪着姐姐，知道不？”

羿锋微微一笑：两人终究没有因为分隔五年而生涩。反而更亲近了！

“秦依姐，我们找个地方去坐坐吧。别打扰父亲的宴会了。”羿锋微微一笑，不想在这个宴会上，因为自己的父亲并不待见自己。

秦依刚准备点头，却被羿母笑骂道：“你们这两个孩子，这说的是什么话。来。坐我旁边。自己父亲的寿宴都想逃，有你这么做儿子的吗？”

羿凯幕微微皱了皱眉头，看了羿母一眼，张了张口，却还是忍住没说什么。

自从羿锋断了经脉之后，作为父亲的羿凯幕，对羿锋的态度就急转直下。在他看来，拥有这么一个废人儿子，那是他的耻辱。

而这一切，让秦依内疚不已。因为她觉得是自己的原因让羿锋经脉尽断，无法成为一个耀眼的灵者。

秦依看着羿锋内疚的说道：“对不起……”

羿锋笑着摇摇头，说道：“天要下雨，娘要嫁女，我要断经脉，挡也挡不住。上天注定的东西，那能改变。就好比让我遇见你。这叫缘分。”

秦依听到这句话，脸蛋微微红了红：呸，这小坏蛋，缘分这东西能乱说吗？？

秦依白了羿锋一眼，但却没有责怪，对羿锋她责怪不起来。

羿锋走到座位旁，对着羿凯幕行了一礼恭敬道。

得，谁叫他们是我这一世的父母呢。老头子虽然脾气臭点，自己就忍忍吧。

“哼……”羿凯幕轻哼了一声，没有搭理羿锋。

羿锋丝毫不以为意，笑了笑，和秦依坐定之后，拿起身前的酒杯轻轻的抿了一口，姿态从容淡定，让羿母忍不住松了一口气。

“呵呵，原来这就是羿爵士的二公子啊。听说二公子经脉俱断之后，消失五年了，难道他去哪里学师了？”一声爽朗的声音在羿锋坐定之后就猛的响起。不难听出语气之中的讥讽。

羿锋轻轻的转动着酒杯，心中大骂道：我靠，本少这才坐定，就有人找麻烦？！难道我真出色到任何人都嫉妒的程度？！这老家伙，要不要给点教训呢？

羿凯幕听到这声音，脸色不由一变，但马上就恢复正常：“艾伯特爵士，小儿因为一场事故，经脉尽断，又哪来的学师之举。你这聪明的人，不会不知道经脉俱断，就和武者无缘了吧？”

有人的地方就有争斗，这话一点都不假。尽管这是父亲的生辰寿宴，可是却也不得不邀请一些不想邀请的人。这一向和父亲作对的艾伯特爵士就是其中一个。

“呵呵，那就奇怪了。那令公子这五年去做了什么呢？”艾伯特不依不饶的说道。

羿凯幕听到这句话，心中不禁大骂：妈的，我要是知道他这消失的五年去做什么就好了。老子逼问了他良久，他愣是一个字都没告诉老子。

想到这，羿凯幕对羿锋的恼火又多了一分：这混蛋小子，早就吩咐他不准到前厅来，居然跑过来丢老子脸，你等着，我饶不了你。

“呵呵，羿爵士，不会你也不知道自己的儿子做什么吧？”

艾伯特可是了解，貌似这羿家的二公子，在经脉尽断之后猛的消失，回来之后更是没交代去向，能借此掉羿凯幕的面子，他求之不得。

“呵呵，我父亲怎么可能不知道我去哪里了。只是我做的事情上不得台面，不好意思说而已？既然艾伯特爵士这么感兴趣，我告诉你又何妨。”

老家伙，虽然自己这父亲是不待见自己，可也容不得你这老家伙欺负。信不信本少叫人把你十八房太太都……嘿嘿，再给你带上绿帽子游街，不知道是不是很有趣呢？

艾伯特笑道：“呵呵，那二公子去做什么了？”

“呵呵，没做什么。就寻花问柳而已！”

羿锋的一句话，让数人口中的酒喷射出来。一个个目瞪口呆的看着羿锋，羿凯幕更是脸都气绿了。
content_en:
Phantom of the Otherworld Xiaoyao Qin Yiming first released on 3G network

To become a warrior, soul, energy, and skills are indispensable.Without any one of them, one cannot become a true warrior.

The soul is naturally the soul. As a warrior, it is the most important thing. Anyone who wants to become a warrior must first cultivate soul power.The soul has been cultivated to an extremely high level, and it is said that the soul can leave the body.Of course, out-of-body experiences are extremely dangerous, and no one would do such a thing easily unless absolutely necessary.

The most important function of soul power is to control fighting spirit.Just imagine, if a soulless human body has fighting spirit but has fighting spirit, it would be like a wild horse running wild, it would be strange not to torture the person half to death.

Therefore, only after a warrior has strong enough soul power can he gradually improve his fighting spirit and improve his overall strength.

The existence of martial arts is to bring out the strength of the warrior.It's like a warrior is a tomb full of treasures, and martial arts are the key to unlocking the tomb.Otherwise, no matter how many treasures there are in the tomb, there will be no key to unlock them.You can only look at the sealed tomb and sigh.Without martial arts, even if you have great martial arts, you still won't be able to show it.

The quality of martial arts is like the size of a tomb door that a key can open.The bigger the door the key can open, the better the access, and the more easily the treasure can be moved.

With a good martial arts, he can even defeat opponents two levels higher than him, which shows.Martial arts play a huge role in exerting strength.

A good martial art can greatly enhance the use of fighting spirit and the power of fighting spirit.It's no wonder that Yiliu was horrified when he saw Japanese low-level martial arts.

If the cultivation techniques of soul power and fighting spirit are the foundation, martial arts are the tools.With a deep foundation and excellent tools, you can defeat the enemy with twice the result with half the effort.

The three techniques of soul, fighting spirit, and martial arts are divided into five levels: star, moon, sun, earth, and sky.Heaven-level skills exist as legends, and earth-level skills are considered to be the top-level skills.It can be imagined from this that the Japanese level is also hard to come by.It would be strange if this appeared on the street and blood flowed like a river without being robbed.

But it happened that such a hard-to-find technique was casually thrown to Yiliu by Yi Feng.Yi Liu could not help but be horrified.

Yiliu's curiosity became even more serious, "Hey, my little brother is too awesome. He won't earn it by being a pretty boy, right?"

Yifeng laughed in his heart and slandered him endlessly.Apparently, he was jealous.

When Yifeng approached the front hall, his running footsteps suddenly stopped. Looking at the front hall so close to him, he suddenly slowed down.

The image of a person five years ago flashed in his mind, with a young and pretty face, bright eyes, and a thin and slightly frail body. The whole person was like a lily in bud.Yifeng once lamented more than once that if she grows up, she doesn't know how she will dominate the country.

But all of this is not the deepest memory in Yifeng's mind. What he remembers most is her eyes, the guilty and caring look, which is breathtaking. Yifeng clearly remembers that when his meridians were severed, she was in pain and tears fell. That kind and beautiful beauty shocked Yifeng's heart. He had never thought that there would be such a shocking look in the world.With that beautiful face and crystal clear eyes, Yifeng felt that his meridians were completely cut off more than once and it was unreasonable.

"Five years. What will you look like?" Yifeng murmured to himself, looking at the door of the hall in front of him, but he was a little afraid to take a step.Only in front of her would he have such a mentality.

Yifeng didn't know that a year ago, two kings fought each other and both suffered losses in order to show off in front of her.Qin Yi's beauty is also exaggerated to the extreme.

The emperor personally commented on this: "Beauty is a disaster that cannot be found in this world." It is conceivable that even the emperor, who has thousands of beauties, commented like this, how her beauty would confuse all living beings.

Yifeng remembered that his mother intentionally or unintentionally prevented his father from contacting Qin Yi. With his father's stubbornness and single-mindedness, and her mother still doing this, it was obvious how stunning Qin Yi's beauty would be.

Taking a deep breath, Yifeng tried his best to put aside the thoughts in his mind and stepped into the front hall. His light step did not attract the attention of anyone at his father's birthday banquet. Everyone still raised their glasses and drank, and the noise remained the same.

As soon as he entered the front hall, Yifeng's eyes stayed in one place motionless, even though it was just a back figure.But Yifeng recognized at a glance that the person in his eyes was what he was looking for. Only she could have such an unworldly temperament.

Viewed from the back, a head of glossy black hair blocks her white neck, and a light green belt is tied around the waist of her white dress, which shows her tallness and slenderness.

Qin Yi looked around, not caring about the absent-minded gazes that gathered on her. She just wanted to find the person who had disappeared for five years.The one she always felt deeply guilty and missed.

Yifeng walked behind Qin Yi and shouted softly, with an extremely calm tone.

Qin Yi's body trembled, and he turned around sharply. Looking at the thin body of the young man in front of him, tears suddenly fell from his eyes.

If Qin Yi in memory is a lily in bud, then Qin Yi has bloomed quietly now, and the tears on her white and mature face are like the rain and dew on the lily.The white dress is tied with a beautiful bow, and she has long legs and a slim waist.The mountain peaks stand proudly, and with the face that is no longer raw, it is full of charm, familiar and dripping, and it actually has a beauty that can turn all living beings upside down, and is extremely passionate.

Yifeng's heart beat violently several times, and his heart was shaking with shock.

Qin Yi smiled, and this smile made everyone lose their minds: "Little guy, you can't disappear for no reason in the future. You have to stay with your sister all the time, you know?"

Yifeng smiled slightly: After all, the two of them were not raw because of five years of separation.On the contrary, we are closer!

"Sister Qin Yi, let's find a place to sit. Don't disturb father's banquet." Yifeng smiled slightly, not wanting to be at this banquet because his father didn't want to see him.

Qin Yigang was about to nod, but Mother Yi laughed and scolded: "You two children, what are you talking about? Come and sit next to me. I want to escape from my own father's birthday banquet. Is there any son like you who does this?"

Yi Kaimu frowned slightly, glanced at Yi's mother, opened his mouth, but still refrained from saying anything.

Ever since Yi Feng's meridian was severed, as his father, Yi Kaimu's attitude towards Yi Feng has drastically changed.In his opinion, it was a shame for him to have such a useless son.

And all this made Qin Yi feel guilty.Because she felt that it was her fault that Yifeng's meridians were cut off and he was unable to become a dazzling spiritual being.

Qin Yi looked at Yifeng and said guiltily: "I'm sorry..."

Yifeng shook his head with a smile and said: "It's going to rain, my mother is going to marry a daughter, and I'm going to cut off my meridians. I can't stop it. Things that are destined by God can be changed. It's like letting me meet you. This is called fate."

Qin Yi's face turned slightly red when he heard this: Bah, you little villain, can you talk nonsense about fate??

Qin Yi rolled her eyes at Yifeng, but she didn't blame him. She couldn't blame Yifeng.

Yi Feng walked to the seat and bowed respectfully to Yi Kaimu.

Yes, they are my parents in this life.Although the old man has a bad temper, he should just tolerate it.

"Hmph..." Yi Kaimu snorted lightly and ignored Yi Feng.

Yi Feng didn't care at all and smiled. After sitting down with Qin Yi, he picked up the wine glass in front of him and took a sip. His posture was calm and calm, making Yi's mother couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief.

"Haha, it turns out that this is Sir Yi's second son. I heard that the second son disappeared for five years after his meridians were severed. Did he go to learn from there?" A hearty voice suddenly sounded after Yi Feng sat down.It's not hard to hear the sarcasm in his tone.

Yifeng gently turned the wine glass and cursed in his heart: Damn it, I just sat down now, and someone is looking for trouble?!Am I so good that anyone would be jealous?!Do you want to teach this old guy a lesson?

When Yi Kaimu heard this voice, his face couldn't help but change, but he immediately returned to normal: "Sir Albert, because of an accident, my meridians were severed, so how can I be a disciple? You are a smart person, don't you know that if your meridians are severed, you will have no chance to be a warrior, right?"

It is true that wherever there are people, there will be fights.Even though it was my father's birthday party, I had to invite some people I didn't want to invite.Sir Albert, who has always been against his father, is one of them.

"Haha, that's strange. So what has Mr. Ling done in the past five years?" Albert said reluctantly.

When Yi Kaimu heard this, he couldn't help but cursed in his heart: Damn, I wish I knew what he was doing during the five years he disappeared.I pressed him for a long time, but he was stunned and didn't tell me a word.

Thinking of this, Yi Kaimu was even more annoyed with Yi Feng: This bastard boy, who had been told not to come to the front hall, actually came here to embarrass me. Just wait, I can't spare you.

"Haha, Sir Yi, you don't know what your son does, do you?"

Albert knew that it seemed that the second son of the Yi family suddenly disappeared after his meridians were cut off. When he came back, he did not explain his whereabouts. He could only use this to lose the face of Yi Kaimu.

"Haha, how could my father not know where I am? It's just that what I do is not publicity, so I'm embarrassed to say it? Since Sir Albert is so interested, it doesn't matter if I tell you."

Old guy, although my father doesn't want to see me, I can't tolerate being bullied by an old guy like you.Believe it or not, I asked someone to take away all the wives of your 18th bedroom... Hehe, I wonder if it would be fun to parade you through the streets with a cuckold?

Albert smiled and said: "Haha, what did the second young master do?"

"Haha, I didn't do anything. I just looked for flowers and willows!"

Yifeng's words caused wine to spurt out from several people's mouths.Everyone looked at Yi Feng in shock, and Yi Kaimu's face turned green with anger.
